podcast.body: Released in 1994, this album was The Watchmen's most successful, selling over 100,000 copies in Canada and achieving gold certification. Its popularity was supported by Cross Canada tours, festival appearances, and Juno nominations. "their biggest album was In the Trees, which came out in 1994 and sold very nicely, north of 100,000 copies in this country."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
